Surveys of the chloroquine-resistance marker crt K76T in IGAD countries

Source: R/datasets.R
igad_crt76t.Rd

Survey counts of the Plasmodium falciparum crt K76T mutation (the marker of chloroquine resistance) in the eight member states of the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD): Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Kenya, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan and Uganda, 1989 to 2024. 328 surveys from 106 studies.

Usage

igad_crt76t

Format

A data frame with 328 rows and columns study_id, survey_id, country (from the location), site, longitude, latitude (WGS84), collection_start and collection_end (the collection window; NA for surveys that give only a date), collection_day (the date used for the survey: the middle of the collection window, or the date the study gave), positive, tested, reference (a link to the source study), reference_year and pmid.

Source

The public STAVE data set (stave_data_2026.03.17.rds, scrub repository, IDEELResearch/scrub, commit 2d85d02; MIT licence), compiled from published studies and the WWARN molecular surveyors. Cite the original studies (reference) when using these data.

Details

Counts are from STAVE's get_prevalence("crt:76:T"), which counts every survey that genotyped codon 76, including those where 76T was absent and those that recorded the codon within multi-locus haplotypes. positive counts infections carrying 76T, mixed infections included.

Surveys were selected by location, not by the country names recorded in STAVE, which are not reliable: a survey is included if it lies within 10 km of the GADM 4.1 outline of an IGAD country, and country is that country. Boundaries are not shipped with the package; the tutorials download GADM with geodata::gadm().
